title: Static and Orbit
author: Xanthe Dunmore
blurb: Wren Thornbury, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
